descriptionZh: 领取人提交固定 Merkle 证明和盐值后一次性领取；到期未领取则由退款钱包收回。仅限 TN10 实验。
descriptionEn: A claimant consumes the UTXO once with a committed Merkle proof and salt; the refund wallet recovers it after timeout. TN10 experimental only.
requirementsEn: Allow exactly one claimant to consume a Merkle-committed claim before a timeout, with a signed refund path afterwards.

parameters.helpZh: 至少 0.5 TKAS/KAS；扣除显式矿工费后的余额一次性支付给领取人。
parameters.helpEn: At least 0.5 TKAS/KAS; the full balance minus the explicit miner fee is paid once to the claimant.

parameters.helpZh: Merkle 叶子和链上签名同时绑定该钱包。
parameters.helpEn: Both the Merkle leaf and on-chain signature bind this wallet.

parameters.helpZh: 到期后只有该钱包能退款。
parameters.helpEn: Only this wallet can refund after timeout.

parameters.helpZh: 决定每一层左右拼接顺序。
parameters.helpEn: Determines left/right concatenation at each level.

parameters.helpZh: 业务域内唯一的 32 字节标识，防止证明跨用途重放。
parameters.helpEn: A domain-unique 32-byte identifier preventing cross-purpose proof replay.
A one-minute shortcut is available on TN10.

invariants: Claimant, claim ID and salt are committed by the verified Merkle root
The claim and refund paths terminate the covenant with exactly one P2PK output
The miner fee is explicit and bounded
No continuation output can preserve a reusable claim

example.scenarioZh: 发行方把领取钱包、领取 ID 和随机盐写入 Merkle 树，领取人用证明一次性取走该 UTXO。
example.scenarioEn: An issuer commits the claimant wallet, claim ID and random salt into a Merkle tree; the claimant consumes this UTXO once with its proof.
rolesZh: 发行方：生成并备份树与证明
领取人：持有证明、盐值和签名钱包
rolesEn: Issuer: generates and backs up the tree and proofs
Claimant: holds the proof, salt and signing wallet
stepsZh: 离线生成叶子和 Merkle Root
领取人核对 claim ID、证明和输出后签名
领取或到期退款都会终止该 Covenant
stepsEn: Generate the leaf and Merkle root offline
The claimant verifies the claim ID, proof and output before signing
Claim or timeout refund terminates the covenant
example.resultZh: 同一 Covenant UTXO 无法领取两次。
example.resultEn: The same covenant UTXO cannot be claimed twice.
example.cautionZh: 证明文件丢失会导致到期前无法领取；这是 TN10 实验模板。
example.cautionEn: Losing the proof prevents claiming before timeout; this is a TN10 experimental template.
